decision: accept a content-integrity gate for declared managed CoreML assets before native loading

boundary.metadata: complete SDK required file set, unique known relative names, direct-file 64-character hex SHA256; reject absent duplicate unknown archive or malformed values
boundary.io: reuse models streaming SHA256; mismatch/unreadable -> ModelLoadFailed, missing -> ModelMissing
boundary.execution: both whole-file and new window sessions verify before calling native pipeline construction; probe stays file-presence only; CPU unchanged
boundary.ownership: models supplies catalog-derived declarations and checksum IO; backend does not download modify or delete models

redGreen.metadataRed: missing manifest reached SDK instead of early ModelIncompatible
redGreen.compiledMilRed: the complete 76-file declared reference still SIGSEGVed with a copied four-byte invalid MIL before this gate
redGreen.compiledMilGreen: whole-file and windowed initialization return checksum mismatch and the process exits normally
redGreen.permissionGreen: both paths reject unreadable MIL using an IO verification error before native loading
redGreen.positive: 76-source-checksum reprobe and short CoreML whole/window plus CPU baseline pass; missing lazy asset category and restored 180s inference pass

cost.scope: five warm release hash-only calls, 76 actual files totaling 419482724 bytes each; no total processing-time claim

review.method: independent source/diff authority-path and raw receipt review
checks: artifact names come from the SDK offline manifest instead of a duplicated list
all declaration validation completes before any checksum IO
no digest caching by timestamps or across tasks
both actual SDK entry points are guarded
quick probes and models download/install ownership remain separate
only the new fixed CoreML profile requires the complete execution manifest
models dependency was already present transitively; no new package versions or online speakrs feature
original assets remain unchanged, all destructive mutations were copied bundles
no signal handler or exception suppression pretends to recover SIGSEGV
limits: verifies declared values, not authenticity of caller-forged manifests; use catalog/ModelManager references
model cache must remain stable during the session; no transactional filesystem snapshot
not process isolation or containment of arbitrary native faults
current 32GiB M2 Pro timing only, not low-memory device acceptance

validation.explicitModelTests: corrupt+unreadable guard, short positive and lazy-missing/restored long paths passed
